interpretation: The exact B source contains the pending1 control logic in both builds. In the isolated B result the physical flow replicated this register and the observed replica net had 228 loads; in the integrated C candidate the corresponding single net has 6406 loads. The C flow completed normally and used the same named placement/physical-optimization/route directives, but it adds the C UART/frame shell and observation/ILA/VIO hierarchy, has a different top and complete C board constraints, and routes a larger clocked design. This is direct evidence of an integration/physical-implementation difference around a B high-fanout structure, not evidence that the B source changed or that Vivado failed to execute. It does not prove which added load or constraint prevented the same degree of replication. The ILA-internal path remains a separate and worse 100 MHz path.
evidence_scope: Read-only comparison of preserved Vivado reports, build manifests, Tcl, and source hashes; no RTL, XDC, DCP, or board contents were changed.
